correspondence_review.objects: The complete arithmetic carrier and its actual source/phase group representation.
correspondence_review.comparison: Actual root/history/phase/source coordinates provide the full action. The character of every occupied invariant/detail/source sector is computed, and faithfulness gives the complete kernel.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: The action has trivial full-state kernel for N>0; zero-prefix phase degeneracy remains explicit. The different physical coloured/scalar decomposition is not substituted for the actual arithmetic sector decomposition.

correspondence_review.objects: The physical fixed three-colour/sixth-root presentation versus the calculated arithmetic dimensions and kernel.
correspondence_review.comparison: The arithmetic matrix algebra has the actual full history/source dimension and its frame determinant-phase ambiguity uses that dimension. The complete joint state representation is proved faithful, so the physical order-six kernel has no arithmetic counterpart of the same order.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: These entries distinguish different outputs: they do not assert an arithmetic SU(3), sixteen-dimensional carrier, or six-element state kernel. The corresponding arithmetic representation, matrix algebra, dimensional formula and kernel are explicit Lean constructions.

correspondence_review.objects: The independent physical coordinate representation and the actual arithmetic complete conjugation representation.
correspondence_review.comparison: Each action has a derived central kernel, a generator of proved exact order, and a complete kernel classification. The arithmetic proof tests the original response matrices before passing to the quotient.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: The physical generator has order six and uses its actual colour/charge blocks. The arithmetic simultaneous source sign has order two; no physical charge value or six-block multiplicity is imposed. Arithmetic states retain that sign, while complete conjugation observations remove it.

correspondence_review.objects: The complete history--phase operation algebra and its full trace-dual matrix-unit adjoint action.
correspondence_review.comparison: The half-normalized double commutator is evaluated on all matrix coefficients. Its scalar kernel is retained, and its eigenvalue on the complete traceless subspace is the actual carrier dimension. The redundant traceless matrix-unit family reconstructs every traceless matrix; its generator equations are proved individually.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: The physical eight Hermitian basis directions and numerical index three are not copied. The arithmetic trace-dual family is redundant and complex, not declared to be an orthonormal real Lie basis. Its own dimension is four times the actual history-label cardinal. The full kernel and trace-orthogonal coercivity are proved; no claim about the different Gaussian reaction operator follows.

correspondence_review.objects: The full trace-free arithmetic operation family.
correspondence_review.comparison: Centred units with trace-dual partners give exactly (trace(X)/2)*I-X/(2*d). Their double commutator equals the existing adjoint operator and uses the same defining generator family.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: The actual dimension d is retained. The arithmetic family is redundant and trace-dual; no orthonormal real eight-generator basis is asserted.

correspondence_review.objects: All Hermitian traceless matrices of the actual history-phase/source carrier.
correspondence_review.comparison: The actual real orthonormal generator family is complex-linearly independent and reconstructs every traceless matrix; coefficients, trace normalization and intrinsic dimension are proved.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: The arithmetic trace pairing is delta rather than delta/2. Its dimension is the actual carrier dimension squared minus one; neither eight generators nor the physical 4/3 coefficient is assigned to this basis.

correspondence_review.objects: The complete redundant Hermitian frame on the original arithmetic carrier.
correspondence_review.comparison: Both Hermitian parts of all centred units are retained; their computed half-trace response and invariance under real orthogonal changes are proved.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: This quadratic response uses a redundant frame and its explicit normalization. It is distinguished from the independent basis and from the physical eight-generator normalization.

correspondence_review.objects: Actual detail fibre and its complete lift to every arithmetic source sector.
correspondence_review.comparison: The lifted detail response is computed from the actual detail dimension, with its basis independence and adjoint law. It is distinct from the full defining and adjoint responses.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: Detail positivity uses n>=2; the complete defining response has a separately proved uniform positive lower bound. The physical defining SU3 value 4/3 is not imposed.

correspondence_review.comparison: The same finite moment algebra retains the dimension correction and the complete mixed Hessian. Static susceptibility includes the collective inverse-curvature term; generated restoring positivity follows from the arithmetic adjoint comparison equilibrium.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: The physical value 31/10 uses 120 coefficients; the arithmetic fourth contraction is 3+12/M_N with its computed M_N. correspondence_review.objects: The original complete joint spectral Gaussian window, its calculated positive source-unit equilibrium, and the actual quadratic score on each precision law.
correspondence_review.comparison: The complete force is twice the weighted loss of the actual Gaussian score mean. Its derivative is twice the weighted conditional variance. The centred potential has zero force at the same equilibrium and its second derivative along every real ray is the calculated equilibrium curvature times the ray square.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: The exact precision comparison is used on amplitudes z > -1/2; positive curvature is proved for B > 0 and z >= 0. The selected integer window is five under the existing least-admissible source-unit comparison protocol. All original labels and multiplicities remain. Conditional variance is not the variance of an uncentered spectral mixture. The physical score normalization and its numerical mass are not assigned to the arithmetic carrier; no full nonlinear path-integral identification or amplitude-uniform positive gap is claimed.

correspondence_review.objects: The full endomorphism algebra of the complete history-phase carrier.
correspondence_review.comparison: The computed double commutator gives a semigroup retaining the scalar kernel, exact decay and a uniform rate.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: This differs from the Gaussian reaction flow. The rate follows from dimension at least four.

correspondence_review.objects: The complete actual arithmetic history-phase/source state carrier and its normalized defining matrix response.
correspondence_review.comparison: The response is computed from the full trace-normalized generator sum. Its actual action, first and mixed derivatives, kernel and flow are proved on the same carrier. Positivity is derived from the coefficient (d-1/d)/2, with bound 15/8 and action decay rate at least 15/4 independent of the history cutoff.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: The physical radial/coclosed configuration and its numerical mass are not identified with this arithmetic state carrier. This record compares the indicated operation or theorem, not equality of the two spectra. State variations and cutoff are internal variables; the distinct Gaussian-weighted generation/reaction operator is not assigned this Casimir gap.

correspondence_review.objects: Local jets of the generated faithful source-frame action on the complete arithmetic state carrier, together with the original connection and coupled state functional.
correspondence_review.comparison: The inverse product rule gives covariant frame derivatives. Their complete trace norm is exactly twice the sum of the existing covariant kinetic energies over all orthonormal state columns. The same columns determine the full frame action, its positivity, gauge invariance, constant-source restriction and uniqueness on the source orbit.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: This is the local arithmetic jet construction. It retains every arithmetic/source matrix coefficient. The coefficient is the actual defining Casimir and the trace is unnormalized; no physical colour multiplicity or radial-response coefficient is copied. The existing continuous Haar operator and arbitrary global differentiable frame realization are separate constructions.

correspondence_review.objects: Orientation reversal transported through the faithful complete arithmetic operation representation, acting on both values and derivatives of every actual connection coefficient.
correspondence_review.comparison: The transported conjugation is an involutive ring map preserving adjoints and the trace norm. Its curvature, connection-value density and full canonical source-frame nonlinear action are invariant.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: This reverses the complex orientation presentation, not prime-occupation parity or source chirality. Arithmetic matrices have the full actual history dimension; the physical colour rank and response shift are not copied.

correspondence_review.objects: Unitary moving frames on the complete arithmetic coefficient carrier.
correspondence_review.comparison: The actual frame matrix has star-times-self equal to identity before the inhomogeneous connection terms are combined.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: The frame size is the calculated full arithmetic dimension.

correspondence_review.objects: The actual three-direction Haar connection fibre and its complete trace-metric generators, with the canonical projective volume.
correspondence_review.comparison: Both branches normalize an isotropic local-fibre comparison before contracting all transverse generators. Arithmetic uses 3*(d_N^2-1) components and its own complete basis, rather than history-coordinate jets or a copied colour rank.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: The mathematical comparison has unit total intensity in its explicitly isotropic class. Its unit-trace generators have twice the half-trace Casimir; inverse covariance rescaling cancels that coordinate factor. This comparison is not the actual joint-field Gaussian covariance: the latter is the separately proved unique full precision inverse. No equality of the arithmetic endpoint and physical TT endpoint is inferred.

correspondence_review.objects: The full arithmetic source-centre potential and its complete source-weighted nonlinear curvature action.
correspondence_review.comparison: Source, connection and mixed variations are differentiated in one actual action. At the unbiased flat source the joint Hessian is the computed source square plus the full curvature Hessian.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: Arithmetic source weights are exponential. The physical affine-shift identity has no identical arithmetic counterpart and is not marked by this group. Background-curvature mixed commutator terms remain in the field Hessian.

correspondence_review.objects: Complete connection jets on the actual arithmetic coordinate and source carrier.
correspondence_review.comparison: The same nonlinear amplitude mechanism is computed directly: derivative curvature scales linearly, commutator curvature quadratically, and their energy contains the full cubic interference.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: All ordered coordinate pairs and all matrix entries remain. The trace energy agrees with negative trace-square on skew-adjoint jets; no positivity of an arbitrary unsymmetrized trace-square is asserted.

correspondence_review.objects: The original complete arithmetic joint charge carrier and its actual two phase projections.
correspondence_review.comparison: Integer charge operators and their primitive coefficient classification, with kernel and normalized quadratic readout on the original carrier.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: Actual phase-rank/history multiplicities are retained; n at least two is required for the simplified neutral quotient. The common source coordinates have four entries, and the right weights are 0,0,1,-1.

correspondence_review.objects: The actual invariant/detail phase subspaces at all four original source coordinates, including every history multiplicity.
correspondence_review.comparison: Charges and sector weights are computed from the actual phase projections and right-source generator; primitive normalization is tested on every nonzero sector.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: No physical sixteen-coordinate basis or one-dimensional vacuum is copied. The arithmetic neutral space retains all histories; the extra neutral sector at root two and degenerate root one remain in the kernel classification. The right generator uses the integer twice-spin convention, and the normalized operator has the separately stated unit 1/(2n).

correspondence_review.objects: Eight actual invariant/detail and source-coordinate subspaces of the complete arithmetic joint carrier.
correspondence_review.comparison: The sector projections sum to the identity; the original integer/real charge, its normalization and the derived detail response act by their calculated sector weights. Generators are existing unit-coefficient responses.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: Every history coefficient is retained. Sector ranks are H and nH; all sectors are occupied for n positive. The simplified unique neutral sector requires n at least two. The right generator uses the integer weights 0,0,1,-1 rather than the physical half-spin normalization.

correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: Actual phase-rank/history multiplicities are retained; n at least two is required for the simplified neutral quotient. The common source coordinates have four entries, and the right weights are 0,0,1,-1.

correspondence_review.objects: Eight actual invariant/detail and source-coordinate subspaces of the complete arithmetic joint carrier.
correspondence_review.comparison: The sector projections sum to the identity; the original integer/real charge, its normalization and the derived detail response act by their calculated sector weights. Generators are existing unit-coefficient responses.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: Every history coefficient is retained. Sector ranks are H and nH; all sectors are occupied for n positive. The simplified unique neutral sector requires n at least two. The right generator uses the integer weights 0,0,1,-1 rather than the physical half-spin normalization.

correspondence_review.objects: The actual invariant/detail phase subspaces at all four original source coordinates, including every history multiplicity.
correspondence_review.comparison: Charges and sector weights are computed from the actual phase projections and right-source generator; primitive normalization is tested on every nonzero sector.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: No physical sixteen-coordinate basis or one-dimensional vacuum is copied. The arithmetic neutral space retains all histories; the extra neutral sector at root two and degenerate root one remain in the kernel classification. The right generator uses the integer twice-spin convention, and the normalized operator has the separately stated unit 1/(2n).

correspondence_review.objects: Complete generated phase-invariant/detail subspaces, full source connector and rectangular covariant observation jets.
correspondence_review.comparison: The native phase average and its complement retain all histories and commute with every original source matrix, hence with the connector. The rectangular jet has unique retained/complement blocks, exact Gram reconstruction and passive-frame covariance with both moving-readout interference terms.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: The arithmetic phase projection is not identified with the physical scalar-spin/lepton projector: they act on different native factors. Their retained/complement and connector-compatibility functions are proved on their actual carriers. Orthonormality and metric compatibility are explicit readout-configuration hypotheses, not root inputs.

correspondence_review.objects: Exterior creation, removal, transport and one-body response on the complete generated source fibre.
correspondence_review.comparison: The actual complete history--phase carrier supplies its own orthonormal insertion coordinates. Its one-body response has a unique derivation extension, and the original source-frame action acts on the same exterior algebra.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: The arithmetic fibre has its computed dimension 4 times the history-label count. Both sectors remain present; the physical sixteen-dimensional representation is not used as an arithmetic input. This is the finite insertion algebra and its uniquely extended action.

correspondence_review.objects: The full original arithmetic history--phase matrix algebra, split along its two generated source sectors, with its actual coupling and complementary block.
correspondence_review.comparison: The arithmetic construction retains every matrix coefficient and returns lifted vectors to the original carrier. The same elimination determines the inverse response, positive lift Gram, resolvent difference and energy derivative. Both trace orderings are evaluated in one state; the constructed state uses the actual Gaussian prefix probabilities.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: Hermiticity is required where the complete block is reconstructed or the real normalization derivative is identified. Inverse equations and the resolvent set state the analytic domain of elimination. These are operations on configured operators of the generated carrier. No particular eigenenergy or observation window is selected by these identities. Source chirality and occupation parity remain separate gradings.

correspondence_review.objects: The full generated history-phase/source carrier, actual left and charged-right projection ranks, neutral quotient and trace of its normalized squared charge.
correspondence_review.comparison: All counts and the content ratio are calculated on the actual arithmetic carrier. At phase rank n and history multiplicity H, the charged count is (4n+3)H and the content ratio is 2n/[H(4n+3)(n+1)(n+2)].

correspondence_review.objects: Finite occupations of the complete one-particle basis of the actual joint arithmetic Haar Hessian.
correspondence_review.comparison: Additive occupation energy is computed from the Hessian eigenvalues. The vacuum is the unique zero-energy occupation; the actual lower edge is attained and controls the occupation heat weights.
correspondence_review.hypotheses_and_scope: This is the finite-occupation core on the complete one-particle Hilbert space. Its gap is min(4, the defining-response coefficient), at least 15/8. It is distinct from the prime-factor Gaussian Hamiltonian and is not an interacting nonlinear Fock evolution.
